personality_one_liner: A highly readable, operational POS system that blends high-contrast functional design with warm, appetizing Italian restaurant tones (creams, terracotta, espresso).

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native rhythm. Tap targets must be strictly >= 44pt for fast use by waiters.

do's: Use glass on sticky CTAs at the bottom of the Waiter order screen.
Use glass for modal scrims when recording voice notes.
dont's: Do not use glass on KDS ticket cards. They need pure solid backgrounds for maximum clarity under bright kitchen lights.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Role selection (Waiter vs Kitchen) to route to the correct UI context.
screens.layout: Top 40% full-bleed image (hero_pizza_oven) with a vertical scrim (transparent to surface). Bottom 60% contains two large touch-friendly cards (Waiter, Kitchen) featuring brandTertiary tinted icons and large bold text.

screens.name: WaiterTableGrid
screens.purpose: Overview of 10 tables allowing waiters to see occupancy, table status, and open a table to take an order.
screens.layout: Sticky header with 'Floor Plan'. Scrollable 2-column grid of 10 tables. Each table tile uses surfaceSecondary. Status (Available, Ordering, Served) is indicated by text color and a small status pip indicator.

screens.name: TableOrderDetail
screens.purpose: Menu selection and current order composition, featuring voice-to-text item modification per dish.

states.empty: Illustration of a pizza slice - 'No items added yet'
states.error: Readable error message for speech-to-text failure

screens.layout: Scrollable view split into two conceptual sections. Section 1: Menu List (Pizza Margherita, Funghi, Al Casa) using small image thumbnails, price (in Euro), and an 'Add' icon button. Section 2: Current Order List. Each ordered item row has a microphone button (brandTertiary tint) to record a voice note. Transcribed text appears directly below the item name in 'muted' text. Sticky bottom container with 'Send to Kitchen' brandPrimary CTA.

screens.name: KitchenBoard
screens.purpose: Kitchen Display System (KDS) kanban board showing order tickets grouped by status.

states.empty: Illustration of a clean kitchen - 'All tickets cleared'

screens.layout: Landscape optimized or horizontal scroll. 3 structural columns: New, Preparing, Ready. Each ticket is a surfaceSecondary card showing Table Number (large text), Elapsed Time, and a list of items. Items with voice notes show a transcription text block and a 'Play Audio' icon button. Bottom of ticket has a 'Move to Next State' CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure UI is strictly devoid of purple/violet/blue gradients. Stick to the provided warm Italian restaurant palette (Cream, Terracotta/Pomodoro, Espresso).
Implement Waiter/Kitchen routing from the Login screen.

The TableOrderDetail screen must show the 3 pizzas with their fetched images. Waiters click to add an item. Inside the order list, each item row must feature a microphone button to trigger speech-to-text recording.
Kitchen KDS tickets must visibly display the transcribed voice text (e.g. 'extra cheese') and feature a 'Play' icon to listen to the audio.
Make KDS touch targets large, assuming wet/greasy fingers. Use a column layout for ticket states (New -> Preparing -> Ready -> Served).
Adhere to the iOS-Native Clean layout principles with large tap targets (>= 44pt). Do not use emojis in the UI.
